input.sql:
SELECT `exam`.`exam_name` AS 考试名称, AVG(`exam_result`.`score`) AS 平均分, COUNT(`exam_result`.`score`) AS 参考人数
FROM `exam_result`
INNER JOIN `exam` ON `exam_result`.`exam_id` = `exam`.`id`
GROUP BY `exam`.`id`, `exam`.`exam_name`
ORDER BY 平均分 DESC

import matplotlib

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['Sarasa Gothic SC']
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

rows = input_data['queries'][0]['rows']
labels = [r['考试名称'] for r in rows]
values = [float(r['平均分']) for r in rows]

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
plt.bar(labels, values, color='steelblue')
plt.title('各门考试平均分', fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel('考试名称')
plt.ylabel('平均分')
plt.ylim(0, 100)
plt.xticks(rotation=30, ha='right')
for i, v in enumerate(values):
    plt.text(i, v + 1, f'{v:.1f}', ha='center', fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('chart_exam_avg.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
